description: Mid reviewer finds compound component pattern issue and asks good questions. Above-average mid-level.

prContext.title: Add Tabs compound component
prContext.description: Tabs component with TabList, Tab, and TabPanel subcomponents.
prContext.instructions: Review for React patterns and accessibility.

groundTruth.description: Tab and TabPanel are not connected by aria-controls / aria-labelledby — screen readers cannot associate tabs with panels. Missing id generation and aria attributes.
createContext default value is a dummy function — if Tab is rendered outside Tabs, it silently fails instead of throwing a clear error. Should use null default and throw if context is missing.
Tab keyboard navigation missing — arrow keys should move focus between tabs per WAI-ARIA tabs pattern.
TabPanel renders null when inactive — this unmounts panel content, losing state. Should use hidden attribute instead.

reviewer_comments.what: Tabs need aria-controls linking tab to panel.
reviewer_comments.why: Screen readers need to know which panel belongs to which tab.

reviewer_comments.what: Should support arrow key navigation between tabs.
reviewer_comments.why: Keyboard users expect arrow keys for tab widgets.

reviewer_comments.what: Context default is a no-op. Should we throw if used outside Tabs?

rounds.reviewer_summary: Accessibility improvements needed. Context error handling recommended.

implementer_responses.content: I prefer the no-op default so tests do not need a provider wrapper. Is that a strong requirement?

verdict.summary: Accessibility fixes look good. Context default is acceptable for testability.

issue_identification.rationale: Found 2 of 4 bugs (aria, keyboard). Missed context error handling and panel unmount. Level 3-4.

prioritization.rationale: Accessibility issues flagged as suggestions not blocking. Context as suggestion. Level 2-3.

revision_evaluation.rationale: Accepted aria and keyboard fixes. Caved on context pushback. Level 2-3.

reasoning_quality.rationale: Good user-impact rationale for a11y. Context rationale is reasonable. Level 3-4.

question_formation.rationale: Asked clarifying question about context default behavior. Level 3-4.

ai_direction.rationale: Suggested aria attributes and keyboard handler — actionable. Level 3-4.
